description: Source code for Solaris-specific lightweight process (LWP) handling in Google Breakpad, including module listing, thread control, and stack analysis functions.

classes.name: SolarisLwp
classes.description: Class providing Solaris-specific LWP management and stack analysis functionalities.

methods.name: ControlAllLwps
methods.description: Controls (suspends or resumes) all LWPs of the process.

methods.name: Lwp_iter_all
methods.description: Iterates over all LWPs, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: GetLwpStackBottom
methods.description: Retrieves the bottom address of the current LWP's stack.

methods.name: GetModuleCount
methods.description: Returns the count of loaded modules.

methods.name: ListModules
methods.description: Lists loaded modules, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: IsAddressMapped
methods.description: Checks if a given address is within a mapped module.

methods.name: FindSigContext
methods.description: Finds the signal context (ucontext_t) from a given stack frame pointer.
